answer: Because the zenith beacon round is committed in advance, the pearl audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 22 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, as the bridge value does not exist until the window has already shut. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
